title: In characteristic zero every field extension is separable
statement: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $0$ and $K/k$ a field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. Then $K$ is separable over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension]: every subextension $k\subset K'\subset K$ finitely generated over $k$ has a (finite) transcendence basis $x_1,\dots,x_r$ with $K'/k(x_1,\dots,x_r)$ separable algebraic.

source.place: Algebra, stated without proof in the proofs of Lemma Tag 00TX (lemma-characteristic-zero-local-smooth, line 38835: 'In characteristic zero any field extension is separable') and of Lemma lemma-domain-char-zero-N-1-2 (line 45378); separability in the sense of Definition Tag 030O

mathlib_match.how: specializes in a few lines, one lemma per clause: for a subextension K' of K finitely generated over k, IntermediateField.essFiniteType_iff (Mathlib/FieldTheory/IntermediateField/Adjoin/Algebra.lean line 118) gives Algebra.EssFiniteType k K', PerfectField.ofCharZero (Mathlib/FieldTheory/Perfect.lean line 306) gives PerfectField k, and the lemma then gives a finite transcendence basis s of K'/k with K' separable algebraic (Algebra.IsSeparable) over k(s) = IntermediateField.adjoin k s, i.e. K'/k separably generated
